import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_csv('/app/bn_sample_10k.csv')
print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
print(df.describe().T)
print("\nCorrelation matrix:")
print(df.corr().round(4))

# Partial correlations: for each pair, partial out all other variables
cols = list(df.columns)
X = df.values
n = len(X)
print("\nPairwise partial correlations (partialled on all other 3 vars):")
import itertools
for i, j in itertools.combinations(range(len(cols)), 2):
    others = [k for k in range(len(cols)) if k not in (i, j)]
    # residualize
    def resid(idx):
        Z = X[:, others]
        Z = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), Z])
        beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, X[:, idx], rcond=None)
        return X[:, idx] - Z @ beta
    ri, rj = resid(i), resid(j)
    r = np.corrcoef(ri, rj)[0, 1]
    # Fisher z test
    z = 0.5 * np.log((1+r)/(1-r))
    se = 1/np.sqrt(n - len(others) - 3)
    p = 2 * (1 - stats.norm.cdf(abs(z/se)))
    print(f"{cols[i]}-{cols[j]}: partial r = {r: .4f}, p = {p:.3e} {'EDGE' if p < 0.01 else 'NO EDGE'}")
EOF

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_csv('/app/bn_sample_10k.csv')
print("Skewness / kurtosis (check Gaussianity):")
print(df.skew().round(3))
print(df.kurtosis().round(3))

# LiNGAM-style check: for each candidate direction of Y-D edge,
# regress one on the other (given U) and check residual non-Gaussianness.
# In a linear non-Gaussian SEM, the causal direction yields non-Gaussian residuals
# for the cause and Gaussian residuals for the effect... actually: regressing effect
# on cause gives noise (non-Gaussian if noise is non-Gaussian); regressing cause on
# effect gives residuals that are mixtures (more non-Gaussian).
for (a, b) in [('Y','D'), ('D','Y')]:
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(df)), df['U'].values])
    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, df[b].values, rcond=None)
    res = df[b].values - X @ beta
    print(f"Regress {b} on U: residual skew={stats.skew(res):.3f}, kurt={stats.kurtosis(res):.3f}")

# v-structure check: skeleton U-Y,U-R,U-D,U-M,Y-D,R-M
# For a collider X->Z<-Y we need X,Y non-adjacent, both adjacent to Z.
# Z=Y: neighbors U,D. U-D adjacent -> no. Z=D: neighbors U,Y. U-Y adjacent -> no.
